caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped box with a decorated surface. The lid and the upper portion of the side of the box are colored in various shades of green, with darker and lighter patches, and feature a band of geometric and floral patterns in green around the side. A thin, gold-colored band divides the upper and lower sections of the box. The lower portion is adorned with detailed botanical designs, including yellow flowers with green centers and a cluster of large green leaves against a golden-brown background. The box is placed on a plain, light beige background. In the bottom left corner of the image, the name "Chas. F. Moss" and the year "1938" are written in red.
title: Hat Box
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
